method: Playwright 1.63 Chromium (desktop UA, locale fr-FR, light + dark colorScheme): getComputedStyle on real elements (h1, h2, p, nav links, buttons, wordmark spans, sections), stylesheet hex harvest via document.styleSheets, lab() converted to sRGB in-browser; screenshots viewed. brand_extract.py (plain HTTP) not usable: site behind Cloudflare.
errors: Plain HTTP fetch blocked by Cloudflare; /fr/templates returned 429 (rate limit) so crawl was stopped after 3 pages.
title: ChapChapCV – CV professionnel, offres d'emploi et portfolio en Afrique
description: L'écosystème emploi propulsé par l'IA : CV professionnel en quelques minutes, offres d'emploi vérifiées et portfolio web. Côte d'Ivoire, Sénégal, Cameroun et toute l'Afrique.

css_variables.--primary: #171717 (shadcn neutral default; NOT the brand action colour)

wordmark.CV_badge: Inter 900 white text on linear-gradient(to bottom right, #00BC7D -> #007A55) [Tailwind emerald-500/600/700], 2px border #006045, radius 10px, 3D under-shadow 0 4px 0 #065F46 + 0 6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.25), inset top highlight white/30%, text-shadow 1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.2)

verified_elements.h1: Inter 800, 47.5px, letter-spacing -0.025em, line-height 1.08, #18181B; second line 'commence ici.' in #FF5500
verified_elements.btn_primary: 'Créer mon CV' / 'S'inscrire' / 'Utiliser ce modèle': white Inter 700 on #FF5500, pill (fully rounded), white circle with orange arrow at right; hover #E03D00
verified_elements.btn_secondary: 'Trouver un job': white on #059669 pill, white circle with briefcase icon
verified_elements.btn_tertiary: 'Créer mon portfolio': white on #18181B pill; 'Transformer mon CV en portfolio web': outline pill
verified_elements.section_pills: small rounded-full labels: orange text on #FFF0E8 (orange/8%) or emerald text on emerald/8%
verified_elements.cards: white, 1px #E5E5E5 border, radius ~16px, soft shadow; icon tiles 40px rounded-lg tinted orange or emerald
verified_elements.icons: Lucide line icons (2px stroke, round caps) tinted #FF5500 or #059669

accent.from: primary CTA buttons, 'ChapChap' wordmark, headline payoff words
accent.rule: LARGE text only (>=3:1 WCAG large: in 1080p video use >=40px bold); never small copy in orange; on dark the accent reaches 6.18:1

accentDeep.from: hover state of orange buttons (14 CSS refs)

support.role: second product colour (CV badge, Jobs, checkmarks, theme-color)
emerald deep: badge border/3D shadow, text on light
slate for device bodies / UI chrome

palette_roles_dark.note: Dark mode keeps the same orange + emerald; neutral near-black (not navy). Footer in dark mode uses a slate gradient #0F172A -> #334155.

fonts.licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (rsms/inter; Google Fonts)

logo_candidates: https://chapchapcv.com/logo.png (1366x484, RGBA but opaque white background, orange #EF8031 slightly duller than live #FF5500)
live <nav> text wordmark (captured by black/white difference matte -> transparent PNG)

studio: studio/public/brand/logo.png (transparent wordmark, 929x246, works on light and dark)
logo_files_local.vector: none published (no SVG); request SVG/AI from client

imagery: AI-styled photographic heroes of young Black West African women (braids, emerald blazer / white tee) holding a phone or printed CV, with floating ChapChap UI cards (Portfolio, Jobs '92 % Match', CV card 'Awa Koffi, Marketing Digital'); one intergenerational scene (mother in lace + gele, coral beads; daughter with CV + laptop); orange studio backdrop with floating app-icon tiles. Hero cut-outs on white with warm orange radial glow. Template thumbnails with a recurring 'LINDA KOUASSI' sample persona.
note: Verified against screenshots in 02_RESEARCH/raw/brand/. Orange #FF5500 is the action colour; emerald #059669 is the brand's second colour (theme-color) used as support, never as a second accent in the same frame.
